scope: Full 447-post saved index + current semantic.js and semantic.test.js source; executed in V8 with node:test/assert/fs compatible test stubs, not a standalone Node process

tests.name: index covers 447 unique published author roots
Molly's seventeenth-birthday gift is SAME_STORY, not new
Hagrid's parents-photo album is SAME_STORY even if hidden in original continuation
different narrator AND conflict produces provisional NEW_ANGLE
new event with familiar character not automatically classified as repetition
known different event with same Molly and watches not confused with Fabian gift
nearby scheduled storyline is not silently ignored
low-score scheduled reference does not block different Molly watch angle
canceled draft ignored; schedule retains separate state
drafted metadata without evidence is REVIEW_REQUIRED
duplicate source post_id is not surfaced twice

limits: Rule-based comparison has not been calibrated on a broad independent human-labeled dataset
Only explicitly modeled events receive deeper conflict analysis; other texts use conservative lexical candidates
The Python builder and direct node --test command have not been executed in an external runtime
NEW_STORY and NEW_ANGLE are preliminary editorial assessments, not originality guarantees
